n, m, mod = map(int, input().split())

# Initialize binomial coefficients
binom = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
binom[0][0] = 1
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    binom[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        binom[i][j] = (binom[i - 1][j - 1] + binom[i - 1][j]) % mod

# Initialize f and g arrays
f = [0] * (n + 1)
g = [0] * (n + 1)
f[0] = 1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(i):
        k = i - j - 1
        f[i] = (f[i] + f[j] * f[k] % mod * (i + 1) % mod * binom[i - 1][j]) % mod
        g[i] = (g[i] + g[j] * f[k] % mod * (i + 1) % mod * binom[i - 1][j]) % mod
        g[i] = (g[i] + f[j] * g[k] % mod * (i + 1) % mod) * binom[i - 1][j] % mod
        g[i] = (g[i] + f[j] * f[k] % mod * binom[i - 1][j] % mod * (((j * (j + 1)) // 2) + ((k * (k + 1)) // 2))) % mod

# Initialize 3D DP array
dp = [[[0, 0] for _ in range(n + 2)] for _ in range(n + 2)]
dp[0][0][1] = 1

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i + 1):
        # Update dp for next i
        dp[i + 1][j][1] = (dp[i + 1][j][1] + dp[i][j][0] + dp[i][j][1]) % mod
        for k in range(n - i + 1):
            ni = i + k
            nj = j + k
            if ni <= n and nj <= n:
                val = (dp[i][j][1] * f[k] % mod) * binom[j + k][j] % mod
                dp[ni][nj][0] = (dp[ni][nj][0] + val) % mod

total_ans = 0
for j in range(n):
    for i in range(j + 1):
        rem = m - (j - i + 1)
        if rem < 0:
            continue
        for k in range(rem + 1):
            temp = (g[j - i + 1] * dp[i - 1][k][1] % mod) * dp[n - j][rem - k][1] % mod
            temp = temp * binom[m][rem] % mod * binom[rem][k] % mod
            total_ans = (total_ans + temp) % mod

print(total_ans)
